title: Browse palette programs and color cycles
changes: Browse palette program headers, typed command parameters and producer tables, retaining null pointers, delay overrides and reserved values.
Display stored colors and preview color-cycle sequences from a selected color with configurable speed, looping and preserved controls.
validation: Synthetic unit rom-data-viewer-palette-programs-synthetic-8henqh4g passed parameter guards, swatches, playback, focus, settings, producer navigation and empty-program handling in Linux Chrome.
Protected EUR unit rom-data-viewer-palette-programs-eur-kh44a5o1 matched 230 programs, 1,135 commands and 25 producer tables, then checked a real color cycle and producer link in Chrome.
Linux Docker unit rom-data-viewer-palette-programs-docker-bjxmey4e matched Python output byte-for-byte; the validated ignored local page retained its previous data and inspector.
limitations: The preview uses stored color order and a user-chosen rate; original direction, task state, timing and live palette effects are not reconstructed. Native Windows and other preview families remain open.
